items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember Richard Morgan? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: You are. Now I made a mistake in my book on Bessie, apparently, I mentioned you in there, somebody told me they had spoken to you that it wasn't you, it was another Cheatham, I think, in Detroit --
You mean Ohio, that was Richard, Dick Cheatham.
